claim: Taught english_01-39 through the one teaching path, the main model reads every sentence the lessons teach with the meaning it was taught, and Phase 1's never-taught sentences as written, from its own store.
hypothesis: A taught sentence read otherwise or not at all, a never-taught Phase 1 sentence read otherwise than written, or a write to the main store by the reading, shows here. Sentences in taught shapes with words no lesson has are measured.
